description: Complete data dictionary for DSC306 Project 11 Patient Record Deduplication

record_id.plausible_range: REC0000001 to REC0054373 (unique string per row)
record_id.reasoning: Only identity (=, !=) is defined. Order is purely arbitrary; arithmetic operations (addition, averaging) are meaningless. Never used as a predictive feature.

source_system.meaning: Hospital department or legacy subsystem that created the record
source_system.reasoning: Categorical department labels with no intrinsic hierarchy or numeric scale. Only equality/frequency tests are meaningful. Used cautiously due to potential sampling leakage (see docs/leakage_statement.md).

registration_date.meaning: Calendar date when the patient record was registered in the subsystem
registration_date.reasoning: Calendar time has an arbitrary zero point (Gregorian origin). Differences between dates (elapsed days) are physically meaningful, but ratios (e.g. 2020 / 1010) are meaningless. Used for temporal train/test split.

first_name.meaning: Patient given / first name (Pakistani naming convention)
first_name.plausible_range: Common Pakistani given names and corrupted spelling variants
first_name.reasoning: Text categorical string. Equality and string similarity (Levenshtein, Jaro-Winkler) are defined, but no natural order or arithmetic exists.

family_name.meaning: Patient family name, tribe, caste, or surname
family_name.plausible_range: Common Pakistani family names (Khan, Ahmed, Ali, Malik, etc.)
family_name.reasoning: Text categorical string. Nominal identity; used for blocking and similarity matching.

father_name.meaning: Father or guardian's full name (critical patronymic identifier in Pakistan)
father_name.plausible_range: Text string, frequently omitted in Emergency registrations
father_name.reasoning: Text categorical string. Equality and string similarity are meaningful; no ordering or arithmetic.

gender.plausible_range: M, F (clean); {M, F, male, female, 1, 2, Ml, Fm} (dirty raw)
gender.reasoning: Conceptually symmetric binary (M/F), but raw data contains 14 dirty nominal encodings. No hierarchy or magnitude exists between categories.

date_of_birth.reasoning: Calendar date on an interval scale. Differences measure elapsed age, but calendar year 0 is an arbitrary convention, making multiplication/ratio invalid.

age_years.meaning: Chronological age in completed years at time of registration
age_years.reasoning: True absolute zero exists (age 0 = newborn, absence of elapsed life years). Ratios are physically valid: a person of 40 is twice as old as a person of 20.

national_id.meaning: Synthetic 13-digit Pakistani CNIC number (5-digit area + 7-digit serial + 1 check)
national_id.plausible_range: 13-digit numeric string (synthetic; never real citizen data)
national_id.reasoning: Despite being composed of digits, national_id is NOMINAL. Digits serve purely as categorical labels. The leading digit represents province; adding two CNICs or calculating their average is completely nonsensical. Doubling a CNIC has no meaning.

phone.meaning: Mobile contact phone number (Pakistani 11-digit mobile format: 03xxxxxxxxx)
phone.plausible_range: 11-digit string starting with 03 (plus formatting noise and sentinels)
phone.reasoning: Phone numbers are NOMINAL digit-strings. Leading '0' is syntactically mandatory and would be destroyed if treated as a numeric scalar. Arithmetic addition and scaling have zero physical meaning.

city.plausible_range: 16 canonical cities plus noisy abbreviations (LHR, KHI, ISB, etc.)
city.reasoning: Polytomous nominal categories representing geographic localities without ordering.

address.meaning: Free-text street, house, sector, and area address line
address.reasoning: Unstructured text identifier with nominal properties. Evaluated via n-gram token overlap and edit distance rather than numeric arithmetic.

blood_group.meaning: ABO and Rhesus blood antigen classification
blood_group.reasoning: Biological categories with no intrinsic mathematical ordering or magnitude.

insurance_tier.plausible_range: None < Basic < Standard < Premium (with missingness from Lab)
insurance_tier.reasoning: Strictly ordered categories: None < Basic < Standard < Premium. Ranking is mathematically meaningful (<, >), but distance between levels is neither uniform nor measurable (Basic to Standard != Standard to Premium).

visit_count.meaning: Cumulative hospital outpatient or inpatient visit count
visit_count.reasoning: Count attribute with an absolute physical zero (0 visits = complete absence of encounters). Multiplicative ratios are valid: 10 visits is exactly twice as many encounters as 5 visits.

true_entity_id.meaning: Ground truth person ID in data/truth/ground_truth.csv
true_entity_id.reasoning: Ground truth cluster oracle. Strictly forbidden during candidate generation, blocking, feature extraction, and inference. Used solely in offline evaluation.

fault_type.meaning: Provenance log entry of synthetic error injection in data/truth/fault_log.csv
fault_type.plausible_range: Categorical error types (typo, sentinel, swap, omission, etc.)
fault_type.reasoning: Generator audit log. Revealing whether an attribute was corrupted is direct leakage.

original_value.meaning: Pre-corruption canonical attribute value recorded in fault log
original_value.plausible_range: Original string/numeric value before synthetic noise injection

injected_value.meaning: Post-corruption noisy attribute value recorded in fault log

is_duplicate.meaning: Target pairwise matching label (1 = same true person, 0 = different people)
is_duplicate.reasoning: Pair-level supervised target label. Highly asymmetric binary target (positives are rare). Never exists inside raw individual records.
